name: com.gameframex.godot
description:
GameFrameX Godot core package — the essential runtime and editor foundation for the GameFrameX framework on Godot. Runtime includes the GameEntry/component base (BaseComponent, GameFrameworkComponent), EventPool (typed event subscription and dispatch), TaskPool (async task scheduling), ObjectPool and ReferencePool (object reuse to reduce GC allocation), typed Variable and Property systems, data structures, Utility/Helper libraries, and extension methods. Editor tooling includes asmdef sync, scripting define symbols management, build pipelines (BuildProduct/BuildHotfix/BuildWebGLTools), mini-game platform integration, PackageManager, UpdatePackages, Cropping, Inspector enhancements, and the Welcome window. Plugins bundle .NET libraries (SharpZipLib, System.Memory, System.Buffers, System.IO.Pipelines) and iOS native extensions. All com.gameframex.godot.* packages depend on this core package.

GameFrameX Godot 核心包 — GameFrameX 框架在 Godot 上的运行时与编辑器基础。运行时包含 GameEntry/组件基础（BaseComponent、GameFrameworkComponent）、事件池（EventPool，类型化事件订阅与分发）、任务池（TaskPool，异步任务调度）、对象池与引用池（对象复用减少 GC 分配）、类型化 Variable/Property 系统、数据结构、Utility/Helper 工具库及扩展方法。编辑器工具包含 asmdef 同步、脚本宏管理、构建管线（BuildProduct/BuildHotfix/BuildWebGLTools）、小游戏平台集成、PackageManager、UpdatePackages、裁剪工具、Inspector 增强与欢迎窗口。Plugins 目录内置 .NET 库（SharpZipLib、System.Memory、System.Buffers、System.IO.Pipelines）与 iOS 原生扩展。所有 com.gameframex.godot.* 功能包均依赖本核心包。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
